dimensions.title: Pillar 1: School Feeding
dimensions.summary: 50.3% of monitored learners demonstrated practical recall of school meal protection, balanced plates, and METU-1 multi-mix porridge enrichment using locally available foods.
evidence_points: Protecting school meals: 178 learners recalled specific local greens (Eboo, Lokaka) and cowpeas for METU-1 porridge fortification
Balanced plate & clubs: 55 active NutriClubs established (2394 members); OFSP & iron-rich beans tracked (121 OFSP, 189 iron beans logged)
Visit 3 verification: 51 of 117 Home Charts returned (43.6%) across 7 closeout schools; 41/42 confirmed youngest child served first
Helpline awareness: WFP toll-free helpline (0800 210 210) promoted across 16 orientation schools & 279 village demos (10 meal theft complaints)

dimensions.title: Pillar 2: Gender
dimensions.summary: 63.2% consensus recorded across male allies (boys, fathers, male teachers) affirming fair sharing at the table and in the classroom, addressing practical constraints (labour, cost, menstruation).
evidence_points: Fair sharing at the table: 223 of 306 interviewed learners affirmed boys and girls must eat equally and simultaneously
Male allies in action: 33,788 boy responses logged across 5 micro-polls with 94.7% agreement (31,998 agreements) committing to share morning water and firewood chores
Visit 3 household shift: 100% (35/42) of closeout interviewees confirmed morning chore sharing shifted & 7/7 schools actively trace absentees
Addressing practical constraints: Dialogues tackling domestic labour (33,788 boys), schooling costs (177 sessions), and menstrual hygiene (120 sessions)

dimensions.title: Pillar 3: Community Engagement
dimensions.summary: 81.2% of oriented schools and VHTs agreed on joint action calendars, driving community behaviour change across 305 of 640 cooking demonstrations.
evidence_points: 305 of 640 Cooking Demonstrations conducted (156 hands-on cooking, 243 strictly local foods, 165 sessions with lead mothers co-facilitating)
Community dialogues with men & elders: 290 of 305 village demos held structured gender/consensus dialogues; 13 of 16 oriented schools signed 4-week joint plans
Clean & smart cooking practices: 252 of 305 demos demonstrated firewood-saving practices & 6 of 7 Visit 3 school kitchens verified improved stoves
METU-1 recipe chart routine: 1,835 take-home NutriCharts issued at Visit 1 (51/117 returned at Visit 3 closeout)
